testCase:
D-14: Hotel booking: dates, guests, filters, a room
Goal: Reserve the Family Room at the cheapest Lisbon property with a maximum price of 150, review score 8+, free cancellation and 4 stars, for 2 adults and a 7-year-old child from 12 to 16 January 2027.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/d-14/
STEP 2: Fill "Destination" with "Lisbon" and choose "Lisbon, Portugal"
STEP 3: Choose check-in "12 January 2027" and check-out "16 January 2027"
STEP 4: Set guests to 2 adults, 1 child aged 7 and 1 room
STEP 5: Click "Search"
STEP 6: Fill "Max price" with "150", tick "Review score 8+", "Free cancellation" and "4 stars"
STEP 7: Sort by "Price (lowest first)" and open the first property
STEP 8: Click "Reserve" on the "Family Room"
STEP 9: Verify "Reserved: Quay Street Inn, Lisbon, 12 January 2027 to 16 January 2027 (4 nights), 2 adults, 1 child (age 7), 1 room, Family Room" is visible

plan.title: Reserve the cheapest qualifying Lisbon Family Room

steps.note: Open the guest and room controls.
Set the child's age to seven.
Search with the selected dates and guests.
Require a review score of at least eight.
Order qualifying properties by ascending price.
Open the cheapest qualifying property rather than guessing its identity.

args.text: Reserved: Quay Street Inn, Lisbon, 12 January 2027 to 16 January 2027 (4 nights), 2 adults, 1 child (age 7), 1 room, Family Room

steps.note: Verify the exact property, dates, duration, guests and room in the reservation confirmation.

reasoning: This tests a Lisbon hotel reservation with the requested dates, guest composition, price cap and filters. The plan selects the lowest-priced qualifying property and checks the exact reservation summary to verify the room and booking details.
